name: Killoren
author: Skip Williams
printedArtCredit: James Zhang, Killoren illustrations in the printed entry
sourceDistinctions: The three selectable reference versions are a single species with one active aspect at a time.
The printed Destroyer smite does not specify an attack mode. Daranvar demonstrates it with melee weapons.
The playable list supplies no level-adjustment field. The new builds use ECL equal to class level based on no stated adjustment.
The published CR 2 traveler is a separate Ranger 1/Rogue 1 example and is not reproduced.
